locations.note: Jodie shelters with a Navajo family on a desert ranch and faces the spirit that haunts their land.
The Embassy: Jodie's first CIA field assignment, a diplomatic party at the embassy in Riyadh where Aiden has to get the documents out of Sheik Ahmad's safe.
A CIA mission in Somalia to assassinate a warlord becomes a turning point for Jodie.

routes.name: Jodie Holmes
routes.note: Jodie's CIA years run from an embassy job in Riyadh to a killing in Somalia that turns her into a fugitive, who finds shelter with a Navajo family in the desert.
